summary: Arvin crouches in the sharp shadow of a rusted turbine housing, scraping thick orange oxidation from a titanium bolt using a bone-handled knife. Milo stands nearby, shielding his eyes with a grease-stained palm as he scans the shimmering horizon for the glint of corporate drones.
settingText: The scorched Mojave around the mobile Launch-Shop, rocket hardware, and the converging Aegis pursuit line.

dialogueInline.text: The heat is warping the horizon, but I know those Aegis wings are cutting through the haze.

summary: Milo slams a dented copper bypass valve onto a scarred wooden workbench, causing a cloud of fine grey dust to rise between him and Arvin. Arvin doesn't flinch, instead reaching out to measure the valve’s warped circumference with a pair of antique brass calipers.
settingText: The scorched Mojave around the mobile Launch-Shop, rocket hardware, and the converging Aegis pursuit line.

dialogueInline.text: If this is off by even a millimeter, the pressure will turn this entire cabin into a pressurized coffin.

summary: Lucia slides a salvaged micro-thruster into the deep interior pocket of her heavy canvas vest, her movements fluid and practiced. Arvin watches her from across the cramped engine bay, his hands suspended mid-air as he holds a heavy soldering iron near a cluster of frayed wires.

summary: Cyrus walks slowly through the center of a smoldering launch crater, his heavy tactical boots crunching into the scorched limestone crust. He stops to pick up a jagged piece of stamped sheet metal, turning it over to inspect a crude, hand-painted serial number with a look of cold recognition.
